title: Climate shift 1961-1990 vs 1991-2020 by month for 54,805 municipalities in France, Germany, Great Britain, Portugal, Luxembourg and Serbia
description:
Change in climate between 1961-1990 and 1991-2020 for every municipality of France, Germany, Great Britain, Portugal, Luxembourg and Serbia: for each month (1-12) and the annual value, the 1961-1990 value, the 1991-2020 value and the shift, for temperature (degC) and precipitation (percent). One CSV and one Parquet file per country plus a Frictionless datapackage.json.

Method: Copernicus ERA5-Land monthly means (0.1 degree, about 9 km), with ERA5 monthly means (0.25 degree) as fallback where the ERA5-Land cell has no value (coasts). Each municipality takes the nearest grid cell to its reference point (town hall for France, municipal seat for Portugal, BKG municipal point for Germany, ONS built-up area centroid for Great Britain); values are 30-year means of the monthly values for each of the two periods. These are reanalysis grid-cell values, not station observations: they can differ from official station normals, mostly near coasts, in cities and in steep terrain. Temperatures are adjusted for altitude: each value is moved from the grid cell's model elevation (grid_elevation_m, ERA5-Land orography, ECMWF) to the elevation of the municipality's reference point (elevation_m, from the Copernicus DEM GLO-90) with a fixed lapse rate of 6.5 °C per km: t = t_cell + 0.0065 × (grid_elevation_m − elevation_m). Precipitation is not adjusted. The temperature shift between the two periods does not depend on this adjustment. Built by open scripts in the repository and checked by a validator script.

Places and licences: France, 34,734 communes of metropolitan France and Corsica (INSEE code; overseas departments not included), from the list of communes on data.gouv.fr (Licence Ouverte 2.0); Portugal, 308 municipios (mainland, Madeira, Azores; DICO code), CAOP 2025 of the Direcao-Geral do Territorio (CC BY) with municipal seat coordinates from GeoNames (CC BY 4.0); Luxembourg, 100 communes (LAU code), STATEC LAU codes on data.public.lu (CC0) with GeoNames coordinates (CC BY 4.0); Serbia, 169 municipalities and cities (RZS code), RZS (Statistical Office of the Republic of Serbia) list “Opštine i gradovi”, downloaded 2026-11-13 from https://data.gov.rs/sr/datasets/opshtine-i-gradovi/ under the Serbian Open Data Licence (SODL, commercial reuse allowed with this attribution); modified: coordinates and climate values added with GeoNames coordinates (CC BY 4.0); Germany, 10,949 Gemeinden (8-digit AGS), © GeoBasis-DE / BKG (2026), VG250-EW, licence dl-de/by-2-0 (Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0, https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/by-2-0), data changed (climate values added); source https://gdz.bkg.bund.de/index.php/default/verwaltungsgebiete-1-250-000-mit-einwohnerzahlen-ebenen-stand-31-12-vg250-ew-ebenen-31-12.html; reference point: BKG municipal point; Great Britain, 8,545 built-up areas (ONS code BUA22CD; England, Wales and Scotland, Northern Ireland not included), Built-up areas, December 2022. Version 1.1.1 (2026-11-13): France, commune 93066 renamed Saint-Denis (the source list gave it the name of Pierrefitte-sur-Seine, which it absorbed on 1 January 2025); no value changed.
